text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to run with the wind and bring a
fresh
breeze through the racing scene.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate having your guidance on
this journey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
